method: Structured JSON from the Gemini API, instructed by docs/PROJECT_VISION.md@main blob 26e29c717e92. Every cited URL was fetched; dead links and pages that never mention the character were removed, and feats, results, conditions and campaign tags that lost their source were moved to unknowns. All records provisional.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings (Books / Films)
characters.summary: Théoden is the King of Rohan, leading his cavalry (the Rohirrim) into battle with a sword and shield, inspiring his men through charismatic leadership.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to aging and manipulation when weakened by dark magic
limitations: Peak physical capability restricted by mortal human biology and aging

sources.supports: Basic biographical details, role as King of Rohan, and participation in major battles.

feats.claim: Led the charge of the Rohirrim at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.

notableResults.note: Théoden was crushed beneath his fallen horse and fatally wounded.

campaignTags.claim: Rides a horse into battle as a cavalry leader.

characters.summary: Elu Thingol is the King of Doriath, wielding the powerful sword Aranrúth and defended by the Girdle of Melian, possessing immense ancient Elven might.

mechanisms: Girdle of Melian (protective barrier around Doriath)

weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical assassination when isolated from his guard and magical defenses
limitations: Subject to physical harm and death despite high status among the Eldar

sources.supports: Thingol's status as King of Doriath, wielded Aranrúth, and encounters with dwarves.

feats.claim: Fought against Orcs and established the realm of Doriath.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and slain in Menegroth over the Naugláfir dispute.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses immense innate power and rules over magical realms protected by Melian.

characters.continuity: The Hobbit / The Lord of the Rings
characters.summary: Thranduil is the Elvenking of the Woodland Realm, fighting with an elven blade and bow, commanding elite woodland guards and riding an elk.
weaknesses: Prone to isolationism and cautious regarding losses among his people
limitations: Mortal physical vulnerabilities characteristic of high elves in Middle-earth

sources.supports: Thranduil's background as King of Northern Mirkwood and involvement in the Battle of the Five Armies.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Five Armies protecting his realm.

notableResults.note: Victorious alongside dwarves and men at the Battle of the Five Armies.

campaignTags.claim: Rides a giant elk into combat.

characters.summary: Treebeard (Fangorn) is the oldest of the Ents, possessing immense superhuman strength, able to shatter stone and hurl boulders with ease.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to fire and burning agents like liquid fire
limitations: Slow to anger and deliberate in action

sources.supports: Treebeard's characteristics as an Ent, strength, and assault on Isengard.

feats.claim: Led the Ents to demolish the stone walls and dams of Isengard.

campaignTags.claim: Ents stand roughly fourteen feet tall or higher.
Belongs to the race of giant tree-herders.

characters.summary: A massive armored cave troll serving Sauron's forces, wielding a colossal hammer and possessing immense brutish strength and durability.
weaknesses: Low intelligence, vulnerable to targeted strikes in unarmored areas
limitations: Susceptible to sunlight turning standard trolls to stone (though Olog-hai resist this)

sources.supports: General characteristics of trolls in Middle-earth, including size and strength.

feats.claim: Nearly killed Aragorn during the skirmish at the Black Gate / Moria.

notableResults.note: Fought fiercely before being defeated by concerted effort.

campaignTags.claim: Extremely tall and bulky humanoid monster.

characters.summary: Tulkas the Wrestler is a Valar champion of physical might, fighting unarmed with unmatched strength, speed, and endurance, laughing in combat.

sources.supports: Tulkas's role as one of the Valar, noted for physical strength and wrestling prowess.

feats.claim: Wrestled and overthrew Melkor prior to the creation of the Sun.

notableResults.note: Subdued Melkor single-handedly during the Days of Arda's shaping.

campaignTags.claim: A supreme angelic being capable of assuming towering physical forms.

characters.summary: Tuor of the Edain is a hero of men who wields the axe Dramborleg, guided by Ulmo to find Gondolin and fight against Morgoth's forces.
limitations: Subject to mortal fatigue and injury

sources.supports: Tuor's heritage, wielding of Dramborleg, and journey to Gondolin.

feats.claim: Slew several Orc captains during the Fall of Gondolin.
feats.citation: The Fall of Gondolin / The Silmarillion

notableResults.note: Defended refugees during the sack of Gondolin.

characters.summary: Túrin Turambar is a tragic and formidable human warrior, wielding the black sword Gurthang and wearing dragon-helm armor, known for legendary prowess against monsters and men.

mechanisms: Plate armor and exceptional parrying skill

weaknesses: Plagued by tragic curse, deception, and psychological despair
limitations: Mortal human endurance and vulnerability to psychological manipulation

sources.supports: Túrin's feats including slaying Glaurung and wielding Gurthang.

feats.claim: Slew the great dragon Glaurung from beneath using Gurthang.
feats.citation: The Silmarillion / The Children of Húrin

notableResults.note: Fatally stabbed the dragon from the ravine of Cabed Naeramarth, though Túrin died shortly after.

characters.summary: Uglúk is an uruk-hai captain in service to Saruman, wielding a broadsword and shield, characterized by brutal discipline and ruthless combat effectiveness.

mechanisms: Iron-studded leather and crude metal armor

weaknesses: Overconfident and dismissive of lesser orcs and external riders
limitations: Subject to standard physical damage and death from bladed weapons

sources.supports: Uglúk's role as Uruk-hai captain leading the captive-taking party across Rohan.

feats.claim: Led a band of Uruk-hai across Rohan carrying Merry and Pippin.

notableResults.note: Slain by Éomer during the ambush by the Rohirrim at Fangorn forest edge.
